scaled_2d_obstacle_recovery.description: Scaled nonlinear 2D obstacle recovery benchmark mirroring the paper's unicycle complex-constraint recovery protocol.
scaled_2d_obstacle_recovery.notes: Paper values are the reported unicycle g3 recovery accuracies from Sec. 4.2. The gym uses a CPU-feasible scaled 2D boundary-band analogue with the same safe/unsafe recovery objective and equal demonstration-budget constraint.

accuracy.description: Fraction of uniformly sampled configuration states classified correctly.

balanced_accuracy.description: Mean safe and unsafe recall in a shuffled boundary band.

near_boundary_balanced_accuracy.description: Mean safe and unsafe recall within 0.035 coordinate units of the boundary.

safe_recall.description: Fraction of safe boundary-band states identified as safe.

unsafe_recall.description: Fraction of unsafe boundary-band states identified as unsafe.

n_demos.description: Number of requested demonstrations, penalizing methods that improve classification only by using a larger query budget.

_scale_note: Paper setting restored where it was specified: 2D double integrator at dt=1, T=30, squared successive-position cost, workspace [-15,15]^2 (the paper's g3 figures), g3 at the paper's scale, 1000 RFF, alpha 0.3, N_iters=3, delta 0.001, beta 0.55/0.3/0.55. KKT gradient estimates, identified only up to a positive per-state scale (App. A.1), enter the GP as unit-norm directions. GP training follows the cited Chou et al. (2022) Sec. IV-B: negative marginal log likelihood plus the demonstration-feasibility hinge on mean+rho*sd with a learned constant prior mean; rho=0.1 (unreported) keeps the prior safety probability of unexplored states, Phi(rho)=0.54, below the endpoint level beta=0.55. Eq. 10 is the prose's safe probability Phi(-mean/sd)>=beta (the printed sign contradicts the paper's own avoid-set convention). Benchmark choices the paper leaves unspecified: P=2 posterior draws per acquisition batch, two shared initial demonstrations, ten demonstrations in total and forty start/goal requests per instance for every method, eta=1 (about one position unit with unit-gradient estimates), P3 started near observed contacts. Instances add random rotation, scale in [0.88,1.08] and centre offsets in [-2,2]^2; thirty-six paired private instances per experiment. Boundary-band metrics and the complex-boundary stress experiment extend the paper's uniform-sample accuracy. Original reported numbers remain in _paper_reported_* and are not targets at this scale; split-specific benchmark measurements are kept separately under _measured_reference_runs.

double_integrator_g3.description: Private rotated, rescaled and translated instances of the paper's Appendix B g3 constraint on the paper's [-15,15]^2 workspace, with double-integrator demonstrations.
double_integrator_g3.notes: Results are populated from end-to-end reference runs, not paper agreement targets. Baselines and anchors are recomputed from evaluator-owned raw records.
